name: Dementia in family life and memory
what_it_is: Videos about dementia as experienced by families: a grandmother who forgets the family dog hates petting, memory exercises with a grandmother, a father crying about his mother's condition, a comedic POV of an elderly man who only remembers viral TikTok sounds, an animated story of a man whose only help during a heart attack is his grandfather with dementia, and a commentary clip citing a politician's repeated anecdote as a sign of dementia. Only the last references a specific dated rally, so the group is a shared subject rather than one event.
